notes: mnn-pocket-0.3b-dec_L1024_fp16w.tflite of litert-community/MNN-Pocket-0.3B-Dec-LiteRT (taobao-mnn/MNN-Pocket-0.3B-Dec, Apache-2.0; the source model's LoRA folded in, linear-layer weights stored as float16): the CPU and GPU form, requests of up to 1,024 tokens; takes the token embeddings [1,1024,896], the rotary tables and the attention mask, returns the hidden states after the final norm (the host reads the answers). Hub main 92110e85 (the tree at that commit): LFS sha256 and size = artifact_sha256 (488,880,528 B), the bytes every record's run read back. Phone rows: the C++ runner on LiteRT 2.3.0's C API (one process per run; the host's inputs computed on the Mac), the run records with their run directories (input list, read-back, setup, clock samples). The line (pre-registered): against the reference (the source model's inference.py, float32 CPU, one thread), the winner equal on every question whose reference top two are more than 0.02 apart, max |Δp| <= 0.02, mean |Δp| <= 0.002, the control above 0.02 where the file holds it, the hidden state finite; on a phone the winner also equals the same file's on the Mac CPU, on an NPU one partition holds every op; a runtime passes on a device only when it passes on every file it ran (metrics arm_files_run / arm_files_passed). output_match stays null: the line is against that reference, not the shared element tolerance against a CPU run of the same bytes. The Galaxy S26's GPU at FP16 and with no precision set does not pass on this phone and has no record.
